C0323.title: Microsoft Exposes Threat Actors Abusing OAuth Applications for Automated Financial Attacks
C0323.summary: Microsoft's security team disclosed in December 2023 that threat groups are abusing OAuth applications as automation tools to conduct financially motivated attacks.
